meta.title: Fibre & Fixed Wireless Access — Activation, Migration, Home Move, Portability, Termination and RFS

lanes.name: Retail / Retention / Support Agent
lanes.hint: Retail Agent, Retention Agent, Support Agent, sales agent, fulfilment-role agent

lanes.name: CRM / Order Capture
lanes.hint: Journey, cart, contract, tracking record, Customer 360

lanes.name: RFS Portal / GIS
lanes.hint: Ready for service search, feasibility, RFS data management

lanes.name: Billing System
lanes.hint: Credit check, billing account, payment profile, billing update, closure

lanes.name: Field Workforce Management
lanes.hint: Appointment, technician task execution and closure

lanes.name: Order Management System
lanes.hint: Order routing, network activation/deactivation, fulfilment orchestration

lanes.name: Number Portability Admin System
lanes.hint: Port-in / port-out request processing with donor/recipient provider

lanes.name: Notification Platform
lanes.hint: Customer notification and feedback survey dispatch

nodes.label: Queue Ticket Transaction
nodes.desc: One activation, migration, home move or portability process may be initiated per queue ticket transaction (BR-001).

nodes.label: Journey & Session Management
nodes.desc: Follows the same JSM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001). Tracking record created and owned by initiating agent (BR-002).

nodes.label: Tracking Record Created
nodes.desc: Tracking record created automatically at journey initiation (Status_Model: Tracking Record New -> In Progress).

nodes.label: Customer Identification & Verification
nodes.desc: Follows the same KYC capability as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer & Account Management
nodes.desc: Follows the same CAM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Capture Installation Address
nodes.desc: Captured from utility identifier or by cascading zone/street/building/floor/flat search (floor & flat only for apartments). BR-020, BR-021.

nodes.label: RFS Availability Search
nodes.desc: Searches point of presence by address, utility identifier or area; auto-fills address; displays service types (Fiber, FWA indoor, FWA outdoor); shows detected CPE/ONT. BR-023 to BR-025.

nodes.label: Address Locked After Check
nodes.desc: Installation address updated after RFS check and rendered non-editable; recapture required to change (BR-026).

nodes.label: Proof of Address Upload
nodes.desc: Tenancy document uploaded as PDF or Word, max 2MB (BR-022, P-01, P-03).

nodes.label: Eligibility & Credit Control
nodes.desc: Follows same ECC capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey. Permits only Qatar ID holders taking postpaid (BR-030). Credit source: EDW for existing customer, Qatar Credit Authority for new (BR-031). Blocks blacklisted/collections (BR-032) and outstanding-threshold breach (BR-033, Open — threshold value TBC by VFQ).

nodes.label: Eligibility Failure Message
nodes.desc: Distinct validation message displayed per eligibility failure so the agent can communicate the reason to the customer (BR-030).

nodes.label: Billing Account Management
nodes.desc: Follows same BAM capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (billing account creation/selection, billing contact model, payment profile, bill cycle).

nodes.label: Product Catalogue & Cart
nodes.desc: Presents only eligible fibre base plans for the service type/segment (BR-050); bundles IPTV by default, removable (BR-051); allows only mapped add-ons (BR-052) and mapped discounts (BR-053); recalculates cart totals on every change (BR-054).
outputs: Cart with base plan, IPTV bundle, add-ons, discounts

nodes.label: Number Selection
nodes.desc: Fixed line number of category free number selectable for fibre (BR-060). Mobile number selectable only for FWA; star number prohibited for FWA (BR-061). Number category and charges reviewed before confirmation (BR-063).

nodes.label: SIM & CPE Selection (FWA only)
nodes.desc: SIM serial number and customer premises equipment serial number scanned and added to cart, only for FWA indoor/outdoor journeys; refused for fibre (BR-062).

nodes.label: Appointment Slot Retrieval & Selection
nodes.desc: Fetches available slots with lead time/technician availability from WFM; agent selects a slot, customer can request a specific date/time (BR-070).

nodes.label: Appointment Notes & Collection Flags
nodes.desc: Captures notes and CAF/tenancy-document collection flags; passed to the WFM task (BR-071).

nodes.label: Appointment Applicability by Service Type
nodes.desc: Skipped for FWA indoor; mandatory for FWA outdoor and fibre (BR-072, P-06, P-07).

nodes.label: WFM Task Execution
nodes.desc: Technician captures ONT/STB serials, mesh device quantity with MRC, wire length with OTC (BR-073). First 2 mesh devices complimentary (BR-074, P-05). Both indoor & outdoor CPE captured for outdoor journeys (BR-075). Task closure with customer feedback required before order proceeds (BR-076).

nodes.label: Workforce Failure Handling
nodes.desc: Fault ticket created if technician reports an issue during activation; WFM task updated on ticket closure; appointment can be rescheduled (BR-077).

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check Out
nodes.desc: Follows same CVC capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (pre-payment validation gate, eligibility/compatibility/cardinality rule check, payment request summary display).

nodes.label: Contract & Documentation (CAF)
nodes.desc: Follows same CAF capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey. Offline signed form upload PDF/JPG max 2MB (BR-082). Digital signature via touch screen embedded in form (BR-083). Skippable by fulfilment-role agent (BR-084, Should). Additional documents in separate section (BR-082). Activity comments passed to WFM task (BR-085).

nodes.label: Payment & Inventory
nodes.desc: Follows same PAY capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey (payment summary, upfront charge/deposit, WinCash handling, receipt issuance).

nodes.label: Inventory Depletion
nodes.desc: Fixed line number inventory depleted in UIM as part of fulfilment flow (BR-092). SIM/CPE inventory depleted to point-of-sale payment system on payment completion for FWA (BR-092).

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: Order submitted once all sections complete and payment status is paid (BR-093).

nodes.label: Order Submission & Fulfilment Routing
nodes.desc: Follows same ORD capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey.

nodes.label: Order Notification
nodes.desc: Same NOT capability as Mobile Post Paid Journey; for WFM activities, feedback/survey done separately at WFM system.

nodes.label: Network Activation / Deactivation
nodes.desc: Fibre: triggered on WFM task completion, status updated to CRM (BR-100). FWA indoor: proceeds on planned activation date without waiting for WFM task (BR-101). SIM activated with network activation for FWA (BR-102). Order status updated to WFM (BR-100).

nodes.label: Order Status to Workforce / CRM
nodes.desc: Order status updated to WFM so technician may proceed; CRM receives activation status (BR-100).

nodes.label: Billing Update After Fulfilment
nodes.desc: Account/product/service/resource info with per-line prices passed to billing after WFM task closed (BR-110). Additional devices captured during installation billed (BR-110). FWA indoor CPE captured at order capture billed at order capture (BR-111).

nodes.label: Order Completed
nodes.desc: Order completion notification received into CRM, sets order status to Completed (BR-112). Tracking record set to Resolved with order number recorded (BR-113).

nodes.label: Instant Activation Eligibility Detection
nodes.desc: Detects from RFS response whether a reusable pre-installed device exists and is eligible for instant activation (BR-130, Open).

nodes.label: Device Serial Verification
nodes.desc: Agent verifies detected device serial number against the physical device before instant activation proceeds; mismatch recorded (BR-131, Open).

nodes.label: Instant or Normal Selection
nodes.desc: Agent selects explicitly between instant and normal activation, defaulting to normal where not selected (BR-132, Open).

nodes.label: Appointment Auto-Skip
nodes.desc: Appointment booking auto-skipped for instant activation; agent retains flexibility to book on customer request (BR-133).

nodes.label: Immediate Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Immediate network activation flow triggered on order submission; agent notified of activation outcome (BR-134, Open).

nodes.label: Instant Activation Failure Handling
nodes.desc: Support request raised and technician visit arranged where service does not work following instant activation (BR-135, Open).

nodes.label: Channel Constraint
nodes.desc: Instant activation available only to field agents on a tablet device; physical device verification not supported on desktop-only agent (BR-136).

nodes.label: Migration Request
nodes.desc: Migration request raised by the customer, captured and confirmed; customer notified (BR-140, Open — request details format TBC by VFQ).

nodes.label: Migration Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Migration permitted only for active FWA Indoor/Outdoor services with no open fulfilment, termination, portability or home-move orders (BR-140A). Ineligible services blocked with reason displayed.

nodes.label: Migration Blocked
nodes.desc: Ineligible services are blocked and the reason is displayed (FIB_MIG_RTL_003_01).

nodes.label: Customer Verification
nodes.desc: Customer identity verification required before migration initiation; migration cannot proceed without success (BR-141).

nodes.label: Fibre Service Availability Validation
nodes.desc: Fibre availability at target installation address validated before migration order creation; proceeds only where Fibre RFS status is available (BR-140B).

nodes.label: Existing Service Retrieval
nodes.desc: Retrieves existing service, equipment, MSISDN, SIM and billing information from the active FWA subscription; displayed to agent before confirmation (BR-142).

nodes.label: Migration Order Capture
nodes.desc: Captures migration order, customer contact preference, language, alternate number (BR-142).

nodes.label: Installation Appointment Creation
nodes.desc: Creates a Fibre installation appointment through WFM; appointment mandatory for all migrations (BR-143).

nodes.label: Telesales CAF/Tenancy Flag
nodes.desc: Automatically flags CAF and tenancy document collection for telephone-originated migration requests; collection flags passed to WFM (BR-143).

nodes.label: Outdoor Device Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: Creates a device recovery appointment when migrating from FWA Outdoor to Fibre; recovery task exists before migration completion (BR-144).

nodes.label: Existing Service Continuity
nodes.desc: Existing FWA service kept active until Fibre installation successfully completed; no interruption before successful activation (BR-145A).

nodes.label: Fibre Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Fibre activation triggered only after successful installation closure from WFM (BR-145B).

nodes.label: SIM Deactivation
nodes.desc: FWA SIM deactivated only after successful Fibre activation; SIM remains active until Fibre activation succeeds (BR-145).

nodes.label: Resource Release
nodes.desc: Releases FWA-specific resources, SIM inventory and associated network resources following successful migration (BR-145C).

nodes.label: Billing Migration
nodes.desc: Terminates FWA recurring charges and activates Fibre recurring charges on migration completion date; billing reflects the migrated service only (BR-145D).

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Notifies customer at migration request creation, appointment booking, activation success and failure events (BR-145E).

nodes.label: Migration Completed
nodes.desc: Migration journey complete: Fibre active, FWA service terminated, billing migrated, customer notified.

nodes.label: Migration Failure Handling
nodes.desc: Retains the FWA service and raises a support ticket when Fibre installation or activation fails; failed migration shall not automatically terminate the existing FWA service (BR-145F).

nodes.label: Home Move Request
nodes.desc: Created through the retail store queue, or via a support agent (customer calls) assigning to the fibre fulfilment team queue (BR-150).

nodes.label: New Installation Address Capture
nodes.desc: Captures new installation address for the home move and checks service availability for the new location (BR-151).

nodes.label: New Location Installation Appointment
nodes.desc: Follows same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR_001_WFM_01 to WFM_06).

nodes.label: Fixed Line Number Retention
nodes.desc: New fixed line number selection not permitted for a home move order; number must be retained (BR-152).

nodes.label: Old Location Device Handling
nodes.desc: Fibre-to-fibre move: no uninstallation appointment, device retained at old location (BR-153). FWA outdoor origin: uninstallation appointment captured for the outdoor device at old location (BR-154).

nodes.label: Outdoor Device Uninstallation Appointment
nodes.desc: Uninstallation appointment for the FWA outdoor device at the old location captured for a move originating from FWA outdoor (BR-154).

nodes.label: Old Location Service Termination
nodes.desc: Terminates all services at the old location on the confirmed move date (BR-155).

nodes.label: Old Location Inventory Release
nodes.desc: Releases CPE and IP address at old location on confirmed move date (BR-156).

nodes.label: WFM Task Execution at New Location
nodes.desc: Follows same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR_001_WFM_07 to WFM_10).

nodes.label: Move Date Billing Update
nodes.desc: Billing updated on move date with new plan/resources at new location and for terminated services at old location (BR-157).

nodes.label: FWA Equipment Carried by Customer
nodes.desc: Records that FWA CPE is carried by the customer to the new location where the move is to a FWA service area (BR-158).

nodes.label: Home Move Completed
nodes.desc: Home move journey complete: new location active, old location terminated and billed.

nodes.label: Port In Request
nodes.desc: Fixed line number being ported in is captured; new number selection not permitted for a port-in journey (BR-160).

nodes.label: Ported Number Capture
nodes.desc: Captures the fixed line number being ported in (BR-160).

nodes.label: Portability Identifier at Appointment
nodes.desc: Portability identifier marked by agent during appointment booking (BR-161). Portability Appointment Date auto-set to Installation Date + 5 business days if identifier marked (BR-161A, Open).

nodes.label: Portability Form Submission
nodes.desc: Agent completes and submits the portability form; customer signs; signed form uploaded before port-in proceeds (BR-162).

nodes.label: Portability Request Creation
nodes.desc: Creates the portability request based on the portability identifier; submits to the Number Portability Administration System (BR-163).

nodes.label: Portability Request Confirmation
nodes.desc: Receives update on the portability request from NPAS after approval/rejection by donor service provider (BR-164).

nodes.label: Port In Rejected
nodes.desc: Portability request rejected by donor service provider.

nodes.label: Portability WFM Appointment Execution
nodes.desc: Triggers WFM task for FLN change based on confirmed port-in date received on or before the captured portability appointment date; date rescheduled based on confirmed port-in date (BR-164A, Open).

nodes.label: Portability Activation After Completion
nodes.desc: Activates the ported fixed line number after portability completion; configured during the WFM task; no temporary number provided (BR-165).

nodes.label: Port In Completed
nodes.desc: Port-in journey complete: number activated on VFQ network.

nodes.label: Port Out Request Received
nodes.desc: Trouble ticket automatically created in CRM on receipt of a port-out request from NPAS, carrying ticket and order identifiers (BR-170).

nodes.label: Port Out Trouble Ticket Created
nodes.desc: Trouble ticket created (BR-170).

nodes.label: Queue Assignment & Initial SLA Timer
nodes.desc: Auto-assigned to the portability queue; initial validation service level timer started (BR-171, Open, P-11: 2 hours).

nodes.label: Document & Mandatory Validation
nodes.desc: Agent validates portability form and identity document from NPAS; documents may be uploaded (BR-172, Open). Form date within allowed period (P-10: 30 days); name, ID number and service type must match records (BR-173).

nodes.label: Outstanding Bill Handling
nodes.desc: Pending bill moves request to Conditionally Accepted with a defined settlement window (BR-174, P-13: 24 hours).

nodes.label: Service Level Extension
nodes.desc: Service level timer extended from initial period to final action period where documents are valid (BR-175, P-12: 24 hours).

nodes.label: Automatic Processing on Breach
nodes.desc: Request auto-processed per the configured rule where no action taken within the service level (BR-176, Open — auto-accept vs auto-reject logic TBC).

nodes.label: Status Communication to NPAS
nodes.desc: Every accept, reject and conditional acceptance action communicated to NPAS using defined status codes (BR-177, Open — full rejection code list TBC by VFQ).

nodes.label: Termination Order Generation
nodes.desc: Termination order generated from the closed ticket, linked to it, wish date set to the confirmed portability date and non-editable (BR-178).

nodes.label: Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Services deactivated on confirmed portability date with a one-hour activation window towards the new provider (BR-179, P-15: 1 hour).

nodes.label: Inventory Quarantine
nodes.desc: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period (P-16: 90 days); SIM deactivated and released for FWA service (BR-180).

nodes.label: Port Out Completed
nodes.desc: Port-out journey complete: service deactivated, inventory quarantined.

nodes.label: Termination Request Initiation
nodes.desc: Retail Agent or Retention Agent initiates a termination request from Customer 360 for an active Fibre or FWA service (BR-200).

nodes.label: Customer & Service Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Validates customer identity, service status, open orders, active disputes, fraud/legal blocks and pending termination requests; distinct reason displayed per failure (BR-201).

nodes.label: Retention Handling
nodes.desc: Routes to retention process where required; retention outcome captured (retained, proceed to terminate, customer unreachable) before termination order creation (BR-202).

nodes.label: Customer Retained
nodes.desc: Customer accepts retention outcome and does not proceed with termination.

nodes.label: Outstanding Dues Validation
nodes.desc: Retrieves outstanding balance; prevents or conditionally allows termination based on configured VFQ settlement rule (BR-203).

nodes.label: Penalty Charge Display
nodes.desc: Calculates and displays applicable early termination/lock-in penalty before confirmation (BR-204; plan lock-in is 3 months per CAF).

nodes.label: Equipment Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: WFM appointment triggered/allowed for equipment recovery where service type and device ownership rule require it, including FWA outdoor device recovery; skipped where not applicable (BR-206, Open).

nodes.label: Termination Order Capture
nodes.desc: Captures termination reason and requested termination date before submitting the order, along with appointment and payment details; consent, reason and date mandatory (BR-205, Open).

nodes.label: Termination Order Submission
nodes.desc: Creates and submits termination order to Order Management after all mandatory validations, consent and recovery requirements are satisfied (BR-207, Open).

nodes.label: Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Deactivates the fixed/FWA service on the confirmed termination date; returns deactivation outcome to CRM (BR-208, Open).

nodes.label: Billing Closure
nodes.desc: Updates billing after termination including final charges, penalty, refund/credit where applicable and service closure status (BR-209, Open).

nodes.label: Inventory Release
nodes.desc: Releases fixed line number, CPE, ONT, FWA SIM/equipment and IP resources based on service type and configured release/quarantine rules (BR-210, Open).

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Notifies customer on termination request creation, order submission, appointment where applicable and completion/failure (BR-211, Open).

nodes.label: Termination Inventory Quarantine
nodes.desc: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period; SIM deactivated and released for FWA service (BR-180).

nodes.label: Termination Completed
nodes.desc: Termination journey complete: service deactivated, billing closed, inventory released/quarantined.

nodes.label: GIS Data Ingestion
nodes.desc: Site and building data from the geographic information system ingested into the inventory management system, the master for building and connectivity data (BR-190).

nodes.label: Go-to-Market File Generation
nodes.desc: Go-to-market file generated from the inventory management system as a full extract (BR-191).

nodes.label: Pickup & Transformation
nodes.desc: Go-to-market file picked up through the mediation layer, filtered and transformed into the format required by each downstream system (BR-192, Open).

nodes.label: Distribution to Downstream Systems
nodes.desc: Distributed to inventory management system (full extract), RFS portal, CRM (delta) and analytics data warehouse (BR-193, Open).

nodes.label: Operator Identifier Generation & Mapping
nodes.desc: Operator identifier generated separately and mapped to the utility identifier through field survey, supporting one-to-one and one-to-many relationships (BR-194, Open).

nodes.label: Ready for Service Status Update
nodes.desc: Marks a building ready for service once ready for provisioning; records applicable service level category (BR-195, Open).

nodes.label: RFS Portal Search
nodes.desc: Sales team searches the RFS portal by address, utility identifier or area (BR-196).

nodes.label: Recommendation Integration
nodes.desc: Receives offer recommendations from the big data system into the RFS portal (BR-197, Open).

nodes.label: Lead Creation from Portal
nodes.desc: Sales agent creates a lead in CRM from the RFS portal using the customer mobile number (BR-198, Open).

nodes.label: Continuous RFS Update
nodes.desc: RFS data updated through subsequent go-to-market file loads and through manual updates from the business (BR-199).

nodes.label: RFS Data Ready
nodes.desc: RFS data management cycle complete; portal reflects current serviceability for downstream sales and activation journeys.

agents.Name: Retail Agent
agents.Relationship: Initiates and progresses fibre/FWA activation, migration, home move, port-in journeys
agents.Purpose / Feature: Journey, identity, cart, appointment, contract, payment and order submission across capabilities CAP-01 to CAP-13

agents.Name: Retention Agent
agents.Relationship: Handles retention step of termination requests

agents.Name: Support Agent
agents.Relationship: Handles telephone-originated home move and port-out administration
agents.Purpose / Feature: BR-150 home move request creation via telephone

agents.Name: Field Technician
agents.Relationship: Executes installation, recovery and uninstallation tasks
agents.Purpose / Feature: BR-073 to BR-077 WFM task capture and closure

agents.Name: Sales Agent / Sales Team
agents.Relationship: Searches RFS portal and creates leads
agents.Purpose / Feature: BR-196 to BR-198 RFS portal search, recommendation, lead creation

start.title: Queue Ticket Transaction
start.does: Starts a single fibre/FWA process (activation, migration, home move or portability) from one queue ticket transaction.
start.makes: A new journey/tracking record owned by the initiating agent.
start.example: BR-001: one process per queue ticket transaction; BR-002: tracking record created at journey initiation.

jsm_journey.title: Journey & Session Management
jsm_journey.does: Initiates the journey/session; a tracking record is created and owned by the initiating agent.
jsm_journey.example: FAR_001_JSM_01: process follows the same JSM capability as detailed in the Mobile Post Paid Journey.

kyc_verify.title: Customer Identification & Verification
kyc_verify.does: Runs identity capture/verification per the same KYC capability used in the Mobile Post Paid Journey.
kyc_verify.needs: Qatar identity document (only accepted document type per BR-004).
kyc_verify.makes: Verified identity attributes locked from edit (BR-010).
kyc_verify.example: FAR_001_KYC_01: process follows the same capability ("KYC") as MPAR_001_KYC_*.

cam_account.title: Customer & Account Management
cam_account.does: Creates/matches the customer and account record.
cam_account.example: FAR_001_CAM_01: process follows the same capability ("CAM") as MPAR_001_CAM_*.

rfs_addr_capture.title: Capture Installation Address
rfs_addr_capture.does: Captures the installation address by utility identifier or cascading zone/street/building search.
rfs_addr_capture.needs: Utility identifier or manual cascading selection.
rfs_addr_capture.example: BR-021: selecting a zone restricts the street list, selecting a street restricts the building list.

rfs_search.title: RFS Availability Search
rfs_search.does: Searches the point of presence and returns service-type availability and any detected device at the location.
rfs_search.needs: Installation address, utility identifier or area.
rfs_search.makes: Ready-for-service result including service types and detected CPE/ONT.
rfs_search.example: BR-024: service types shown are Fiber, FWA indoor and FWA outdoor.

rfs_addr_lock.title: Address Locked After Check
rfs_addr_lock.does: Locks the installation address as read-only after the RFS check.
rfs_addr_lock.example: BR-026: the installation address is read only after the ready for service check and can only be changed by recapture.

rfs_poa_upload.title: Proof of Address Upload
rfs_poa_upload.does: Uploads a tenancy document as proof of address.
rfs_poa_upload.example: BR-022 / P-01 / P-03: max 2MB, PDF or Word format; non-conforming files are rejected.

ecc_check.title: Eligibility & Credit Control
ecc_check.does: Validates connection-type eligibility and runs the credit check.
ecc_check.needs: Verified customer identity, postpaid connection type.
ecc_check.makes: Eligibility decision with a distinct failure message per condition.
ecc_check.example: FAR_001_ECC_03: each eligibility failure condition displays its own configured message.

ecc_fail.title: Eligibility Failure Message
ecc_fail.does: Shows a distinct message for the specific eligibility failure.
ecc_fail.makes: Displayed failure reason; journey does not proceed.
ecc_fail.example: Each eligibility failure condition displays its own message from the configured message catalogue.

bam_billing.title: Billing Account Management
bam_billing.does: Creates or selects the billing account and captures the billing profile.
bam_billing.example: FAR_001_BAM_01: process follows the same capability ("BAM") as MPAR_001_BAM_*.

qpc_plan.title: Product Catalogue & Cart
qpc_plan.does: Builds the cart: eligible base plan, default IPTV bundle (removable), mapped add-ons and discounts, live recalculation.
qpc_plan.needs: Service type available at address, customer segment.
qpc_plan.example: BR-051 (Open): IPTV bundled by default with the base plan and may be removed by the agent at customer request.

num_select.title: Number Selection
num_select.does: Selects a fixed line number (fibre) or a mobile number (FWA only, no star numbers).
num_select.makes: Number added to cart, reviewed before confirmation.
num_select.example: BR-061: a mobile number is selectable only for a fixed wireless access journey and a star number is not permitted for FWA.

sim_select.title: SIM & CPE Selection (FWA only)
sim_select.does: Scans SIM and CPE serial numbers into the cart for FWA journeys.
sim_select.makes: SIM and CPE lines added to cart (FWA only).
sim_select.example: BR-062: SIM and CPE are scanned only for a fixed wireless access journey.

wfm_slot.title: Appointment Slot Retrieval & Selection
wfm_slot.does: Fetches and lets the agent select an appointment slot.
wfm_slot.example: BR-070: available appointment slots with lead time and technician availability are fetched from WFM and the selected slot is passed back.

wfm_applicability.title: Appointment Applicability by Service Type
wfm_applicability.does: Determines whether appointment booking is required.
wfm_applicability.needs: Service type (fibre, FWA indoor, FWA outdoor).
wfm_applicability.makes: Skip (FWA indoor) or mandatory booking (fibre / FWA outdoor) decision.
wfm_applicability.example: P-06/P-07: FWA indoor appointment = Skipped; FWA outdoor appointment = Mandatory.

wfm_task.title: WFM Task Execution
wfm_task.does: Technician executes the installation task and captures device/resource data.
wfm_task.makes: ONT/STB serials, mesh device count & charge, wire length & charge, task closure with feedback.
wfm_task.example: BR-074 / P-05: the first two mesh devices are complimentary; further devices carry the configured monthly recurring charge.

wfm_fail.title: Workforce Failure Handling
wfm_fail.does: Creates a fault ticket for a reported installation issue and allows rescheduling.
wfm_fail.example: BR-077: a reported installation issue creates a fault ticket, updates the task on closure and allows the appointment to be rescheduled.

cvc_checkout.title: Cart Validation & Check Out
cvc_checkout.does: Runs pre-payment validation and displays the payment request summary.
cvc_checkout.makes: Validated, checked-out cart ready for contract.
cvc_checkout.example: FAR_001_CVC_01: process follows the same capability ("CVC") as MPAR_001_CVC_*.

caf_contract.title: Contract & Documentation (CAF)
caf_contract.does: Generates/collects the signed contract application form and supporting documents.
caf_contract.example: BR-084: the contract application form submission step may be skipped by an agent holding the fulfilment role.

pay_payment.title: Payment & Inventory
pay_payment.does: Processes the upfront payment and issues the receipt.
pay_payment.example: FAR_001_PAY_01: process follows the same capability ("PAY") as MPAR_001_PAY_*.

pay_inventory.title: Inventory Depletion
pay_inventory.does: Depletes number/SIM/CPE inventory on payment completion.
pay_inventory.example: BR-092: fixed line number inventory depleted for fibre, and SIM/equipment inventory depleted for FWA, on payment completion.

ord_submit.title: Order Submission
ord_submit.does: Submits the order once all sections are complete and payment is paid.
ord_submit.example: BR-093: the submit action is enabled only when all sections are complete and payment status is paid.

not_order.title: Order Notification
not_order.example: FAR_001_NOT_01: for WFM activities feedback & survey will be done separately at the WFM system.

net_activation.title: Network Activation / Deactivation
net_activation.does: Triggers network activation via the order management system.
net_activation.needs: WFM task completion (fibre) or planned activation date (FWA indoor).
net_activation.makes: Activated network status pushed to CRM.
net_activation.example: BR-101: network activation proceeds on the planned activation date without a WFM task for FWA indoor.

fin_billing_update.title: Billing Update After Fulfilment
fin_billing_update.does: Sends account/product/service/resource information with per-line prices to billing.
fin_billing_update.needs: WFM task closure (or order capture data for FWA indoor).
fin_billing_update.example: BR-111: FWA indoor CPE is billed from order-capture data; fibre and FWA outdoor bill from the WFM task data.

fin_order_complete.title: Order Completed
fin_order_complete.does: Sets order status to completed and resolves the tracking record.
fin_order_complete.example: BR-113: order completion sets the tracking record to resolved with the order number recorded.

ins_detect.title: Instant Activation Eligibility Detection
ins_detect.does: Checks RFS response for a reusable pre-installed device eligible for instant activation.
ins_detect.example: BR-130 (Open): the RFS response indicates device presence and instant activation eligibility for an eligible location.

ins_verify.title: Device Serial Verification
ins_verify.does: Confirms the physical device serial matches the RFS-detected device.
ins_verify.example: BR-131 (Open): instant activation does not proceed until the agent confirms the serial number match.

ins_fail.title: Instant Activation Failure Handling
ins_fail.does: Raises a support request and arranges a technician visit on instant-activation failure.
ins_fail.example: BR-135 (Open): a non working service following instant activation raises a support request and arranges a technician visit.

ins_channel.title: Channel Constraint
ins_channel.does: Restricts instant activation to tablet-equipped field agents.
ins_channel.example: BR-136: instant activation is offered on a tablet field agent device and is not offered on a desktop only agent.

mig_eligibility.title: Migration Eligibility Validation
mig_eligibility.does: Validates the source FWA service is eligible for migration to Fibre.
mig_eligibility.needs: Active FWA Indoor/Outdoor service, no conflicting open orders.
mig_eligibility.example: BR-140A: migration is permitted only from active FWA Indoor or FWA Outdoor services to Fibre.

mig_outdoor_recovery.title: Outdoor Device Recovery Appointment
mig_outdoor_recovery.does: Books a device-recovery appointment for FWA Outdoor -> Fibre migrations.
mig_outdoor_recovery.makes: Recovery task prior to migration completion.
mig_outdoor_recovery.example: BR-144: FWA Outdoor migrations require separate outdoor device recovery.

mig_failure.title: Migration Failure Handling
mig_failure.does: Retains the existing FWA service and raises a support ticket on Fibre installation/activation failure.
mig_failure.example: BR-145F: failed Fibre migration shall not automatically terminate the existing FWA service.

hmv_device_decision.title: Old Location Device Handling
hmv_device_decision.does: Decides whether the old-location device is retained or uninstalled.
hmv_device_decision.needs: Origin service type of the move.
hmv_device_decision.makes: Retention (fibre-to-fibre) or uninstallation appointment (FWA outdoor origin).
hmv_device_decision.example: BR-153: no uninstallation appointment for a fibre-to-fibre home move; BR-154: uninstallation appointment captured for FWA outdoor origin.

fpi_identifier.title: Portability Identifier at Appointment
fpi_identifier.does: Marks the portability identifier and sets the initial portability appointment date.
fpi_identifier.makes: Portability identifier flag; provisional appointment date.
fpi_identifier.example: BR-161A (Open): the Portability Appointment Date is auto set to Installation Date + 5 business days (excluding Friday and Saturday).

fpi_confirm.title: Portability Request Confirmation
fpi_confirm.does: Receives the donor service provider's approve/reject decision from NPAS.
fpi_confirm.example: BR-164: NPAS updates the portability request status back after it is approved or rejected by the donor service provider.

fpi_activation.title: Portability Activation After Completion
fpi_activation.does: Activates the ported number after completion, configured during the WFM task.
fpi_activation.example: BR-165: the ported number is activated after portability completion and configured during the field workforce management task, providing no temporary number.

fpo_validate.title: Document & Mandatory Validation
fpo_validate.does: Validates the portability form, identity document, and mandatory field matches.
fpo_validate.needs: Portability form and identity document from NPAS.
fpo_validate.example: BR-173 / P-10: form date must be within 30 days; name, identity document number and service type must match system records.

fpo_breach.title: Automatic Processing on Breach
fpo_breach.does: Auto-processes the port-out request when the service level is breached.
fpo_breach.needs: SLA timer expiry with no agent action.
fpo_breach.example: BR-176 (Open): the auto accept against auto reject logic is to be confirmed.

fpo_status_comm.title: Status Communication to NPAS
fpo_status_comm.does: Reports the accept/reject/conditional-accept decision back to NPAS.
fpo_status_comm.example: BR-177 (Open): the full rejection code list is to be supplied by VFQ.

ter_retention.title: Retention Handling
ter_retention.does: Routes the request through the retention process and captures its outcome.
ter_retention.makes: Retention outcome: retained, proceed to terminate, or customer unreachable.
ter_retention.example: BR-202: retention outcome is captured as retained, proceed to terminate or customer unreachable before the next step.

ter_penalty.title: Penalty Charge Display
ter_penalty.does: Calculates and displays the early-termination or lock-in penalty.
ter_penalty.example: BR-204: plan lock-in is 3 months as mentioned in the CAF.
